topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session, connects it to recent practical work, and outlines the learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor virology, proto-oncogenes, and cellular transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of transforming viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays to assess cell transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, tumor suppressor genes, and mutation mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define functional categories of cancer mutations and examine how alterations in oncogenes and tumor suppressors disrupt cell cycle control and protein activity.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how failures in DNA repair, replication, and mitotic chromosome segregation produce sequence and chromosomal instability with downstream cellular stresses.

topics.label: Multistep tumorigenesis and hereditary cancer predispositions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the stepwise accumulation of mutations during cancer progression and explain how inherited germline defects accelerate this pathway.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session, suggests recommended reading, and previews the upcoming lecture on the hallmarks of cancer.
